actions_today: Draft two starting QBs by the end of round 6. Elite run: Allen, Maye, Lamar, Burrow, Daniels, Hurts. Second wave: Williams, Herbert, Dak, Lawrence, Dart.
Do not draft Josh Jacobs. Take MarShawn Lloyd in the 7th–10th.
If you draft Jeanty, draft Mike Washington Jr. Same draft: Mahomes → Fields, Love → Allgeier, CMC → Jordan James (cheap).
Fade IR/PUP before the last two rounds: Conner, Kamara, Charbonnet, Guerendo, Dell, Higgins, Kirk, Tyson, Musgrave.
Values vs Sleeper SF ADP (Aug 30): Lloyd, Etienne, Allgeier, Fields, Price. Fades: Jacobs at ~4.12, Mahomes as a QB1, Tyreek (no team).
Do not spend FAAB today unless your league already drafted and someone dropped Lloyd, Fields, Allgeier, Washington, or Price.
Wednesday lock names if you draft after Sep 7: Maye, JSN, Henderson, Darnold, Price.

Watch into the next packet: Jeanty practice, Love practice, Nacua/Evans/Kittle full practice, Mahomes full-team work, Hall groin, Chase knee, Flowers, Warren, Egbuka, Penix, NFL waiver claims on skill players.
